relationshipIdentity.description: Observed relationship and identity continuity, descriptive rather than prescriptive.

emotionInteraction.description: Observed emotional or interaction events with context; never instructions for how the assistant should respond.

todos.description: Only unfinished tasks explicitly requested or mutually agreed; no inferred follow-up duties.

preferences.description: Only stable preferences explicitly stated or repeatedly evidenced; never generalize one interaction into a rule.
